description: Exact formulas of the Revision field theory (SPEC sections 1-4, 6) for the corrected primordial metric of 2026-10-16 (general a4 and b4, every real z), for the documents. Every formula is verified by a named check of Revision/theory/reports/wolfram-field-theory.json. Wolfram InputForm; g[xa] = gamma^(xa) of Revision/algebra/gammas.json; a4' = Derivative[1][a4][x4]; b4' = Derivative[1][b4][x4]; z = 6 H x0; rftSig = sign(Cot z); Psibar = Psi^dagger C; S = Psibar Psi; V = m + U'(S); both statistics unless stated.

formulas.description: the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (SPEC section 1, version 2), coordinates x0..x7, every real z
f_a in e^a_mu = f_a delta^a_mu, a = x0..x7 (f0 signed)
sqrt|det g| = rftSig f0...f7, rftSig = sign(Cot z) = +-1
frame metric eta_ab, order x0..x7

formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/4) (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi)

formulas.description: diagonal components (no sum), both statistics; K_mu = kinetic term of direction mu
formulas.wl: K_mu = (1/(2 f_mu)) (Psibar gamma^(mu) d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^(mu) Psi); L0 = sum_mu K_mu - m S - U(S); T^mu_mu = L0 - K_mu; rho = -T^x4_x4 = -sum_(mu != x4) K_mu + m S + U; p3 = T^x1_x1 (= T^x2_x2 = T^x3_x3 for isotropic states) = sum_(mu != x1) K_mu - m S - U; p_t = T^x5_x5 = sum_(mu != x5) K_mu - m S - U; p0 = T^x0_x0 = sum_(mu != x0) K_mu - m S - U

formulas.description: split into kinetic (derivative) and potential parts
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = T_kin^nu_mu + T_pot^nu_mu, T_pot^nu_mu = -delta^nu_mu (m S + U(S)), T_kin^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu sum_l K_l - (1/4)(Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi); potential energy density rho_pot = m S + U, potential pressure p_pot = -(m S + U) in every direction

formulas.description: trace

formulas.description: homogeneous states (Psi depends on x4 only): K_mu = 0 for mu != x4 and K_x4 = (m + U') S on shell (the scalar factor E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) of Psi and Psibar cancels in K_x4)

formulas.description: exact solutions used as test points (checks exact_solution_*), general a4 and b4, every real z; K = g[x4].g[x0], Fsc = E^(a4/2) b4^(-1), muA = (3/2) H (4 al + 1) E^a4 b4^(-1/2)
formulas.wl: (i-a) U = 0, m = 0: Psi = Fsc (Sin[z]^2)^(al/2) (Cosh[I] + Sinh[I] K) chi, I' = muA; (i-b) U = 0, al = -1/4: Psi = Fsc (Sin[z]^2)^(-1/8) (Cos[m x4] - Sin[m x4] g[x4]) chi; (ii) U = (lam/2) S^2, homogeneous, commuting: Psi = Fsc chi for every solution of chi' = (-(m + lam E^a4 b4^(-2) S0) g[x4] + (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) K) chi, S0 = chi^dagger C chi constant, S = E^a4 b4^(-2) S0; (iii) Grassmann, m = 0: Psi = Fsc sum_k [P c_k + lam S0 eta_k] theta_k, P = Cosh[I0] + Sinh[I0] K, I0' = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2), eta_k = -P g[x4] (Ic + Is K) c_k, Ic' = Fsc^2 Cosh[2 I0], Is' = Fsc^2 Sinh[2 I0], S0 = sum_kl thetabar_k theta_l c_k^dagger C c_l; at (ii) and (iii): rho = m S + lam S^2/2, p3 = p_t = p0 = lam S^2/2

formulas.description: canonical quantisation of dirac16complex (SPEC section 6), x4 the evolution time, sqrt g = E^-a4 b4^2 |Cot[z]| (Sin[z]^2)^(1/4)
formulas.wl: pi_A = (i/2) sqrt g (Psi^dagger B)_A; K = sqrt g C gamma^(x4) = i sqrt g B; {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)}_(x4 = y4) = B_AC delta^7(x - y)/sqrt g; B = -i C gamma^(x4), B^dagger = B, B^2 = 1, signature (8,8); no positive inner product with Psi^dagger the adjoint (Krein space, fundamental symmetry B); positive representation chi = Psi^dagger B, {Psi_A, chi_C} = delta_AC; Heisenberg: d4 Psi = -i B (1/sqrt g) dHd/dPsi^dagger = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U') Psi - sum_(a != x4) gamma^a D_a Psi]; mode operator h = m (-i g[x4]) + sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) i g[x4].g[xa] d_a + (3/2) i H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) g[x4].g[x0] - i (b4'/b4 - a4'/2); good sector (no x5, x6, x7 dependence): integral sqrt g u^dagger v d^7x conserved up to boundary terms (the anti-Hermitian term compensates d_x4 sqrt g = (2 b4'/b4 - a4') sqrt g), positive Fock space, normal-ordered H = sum E (b^* b + d^* d) >= 0 per momentum; expectation-value rule <Psi^dagger M Psi> = u^dagger B M u (u^dagger u = 1, positive-energy good-sector u); EMT operator T^mu_nu = :T^mu_nu[Psi, Psi^dagger = chi B]: (normal ordered), <T> by the same rule; extra-time modes: E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2 < 0 for k_t^2 > m^2 + k_s^2, growing as exp(|E| x4)
